mechanism: Posaconazole inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing levodopa/carbidopa levels and CNS effects; additionally, azole antifungals may increase dopamine receptor sensitivity or affect gastrointestinal absorption.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa side effects (dyskinesias, nausea, orthostatic hypotension); consider carbidopa levodopa dose reduction if toxicity emerges; ensure adequate monitoring during concurrent use.
